verdict.rationale: Recurly documents usage-based add-ons that track measured units and charge at the end of each billing cycle, and says measured units support consistent reporting. That implies usage is recorded during the cycle, but nothing shows it is surfaced in real time to customers or the team. Missing for 10: real-time current-cycle usage and accrued-cost views for customers and internal teams, configurable usage or spend thresholds, alerts before invoicing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
